comment: picq-regen-manifest.json — image regeneration lane for Claude Code. PROCESS PER IMAGE: generate via Higgsfield (nano_banana_2, 1:1, count 1) -> download -> compress if >4.5MB -> READ THE PIXELS and verify against 'accept' criteria (counting images: the count in your description MUST equal required_count; if not, adjust prompt emphasis and RETRY, max 4 attempts, then surface to Chris) -> upload to flashcard-images as target_filename -> write image_catalog row -> rewrite picture_quiz_questions options where old option text matches wire_option_text within wire_subject. Style suffix for ALL prompts: 'Soft cel-shaded children's storybook illustration style, clean rounded linework, bright cheerful colors, warm and wholesome mood, square composition. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers.' NOTE 'no numbers' added for counting images — digits in the art would give answers away.

images.prompt: Exactly two large yellow five-pointed stars with dark blue outlines, arranged side by side with wide spacing, very easy to count, plain white background.
Exactly three large yellow five-pointed stars with dark blue outlines, arranged in a single row with wide spacing, very easy to count, plain white background.
Exactly four large yellow five-pointed stars with dark blue outlines, arranged in a two-by-two grid with wide spacing, very easy to count, plain white background.
Exactly five large yellow five-pointed stars with dark blue outlines, arranged as a row of three above a row of two, wide spacing, very easy to count, plain white background.
Exactly six large yellow five-pointed stars with dark blue outlines, arranged in a three-by-two grid with wide spacing, very easy to count, plain white background.
Exactly seven large yellow five-pointed stars with dark blue outlines, arranged as a row of four above a row of three, wide spacing, very easy to count, plain white background.
Exactly eight large yellow five-pointed stars with dark blue outlines, arranged in a four-by-two grid with wide spacing, very easy to count, plain white background.
Exactly nine large yellow five-pointed stars with dark blue outlines, arranged in a three-by-three grid with wide spacing, very easy to count, plain white background.
Exactly ten large yellow five-pointed stars with dark blue outlines, arranged in a five-by-two grid with wide spacing, very easy to count, plain white background.
Exactly three friendly cartoon dogs sitting in a row on green grass, each dog a different color (brown, white, spotted), wide spacing between them, very easy to count, plain light background.
Exactly two shiny red apples with brown stems sitting side by side on a wooden table, wide spacing, very easy to count, plain background.
Exactly five shiny red apples with brown stems arranged as a row of three above a row of two on a wooden table, wide spacing, very easy to count, plain background.
A wicker basket overflowing with many shiny red apples, at least fifteen apples with several spilling onto the wooden table, clearly a large amount.
images.accept: description indicates a large number of apples (10+/many/overflowing)

images.prompt: Two open cardboard egg cartons completely full of white eggs, at least a dozen eggs visible, on a wooden table, clearly a large amount.
A large plate piled high with many chocolate chip cookies, at least twelve cookies stacked and overlapping, on a wooden table, clearly a large amount.
Many colorful teacups crowded together on a wooden shelf, at least ten cups in different colors, clearly a large amount.
A big market pile of many bright oranges with green leaves, at least fifteen oranges heaped together, clearly a large amount.
Two tall stacks of many colorful books on a wooden table, at least twelve books in different colors, clearly a large amount.

Cutaway side view of a small green plant growing in brown soil: green leaves and stem above the ground line, and long branching white-tan roots clearly visible below the soil in cross-section, the roots are the main focus.
images.accept: description mentions roots below soil / underground cross-section

images.prompt: A warm glowing table lamp with a yellow lampshade standing on a small wooden bedside table inside a cozy bedroom at night, soft light rays, the lamp is the single main subject.
images.accept: description centers on a lamp giving light indoors, no animal present

images.prompt: One friendly cartoon penguin with BLACK back, head and wings and a white belly, orange beak and orange feet, standing on ice, the penguin's black color clearly visible.
images.accept: description says the penguin is black and white (NOT blue)

images.prompt: One friendly cartoon zebra with clear black and white stripes standing on green grass, side view, the stripes clearly visible.
images.accept: description says a zebra with black and white stripes

images.prompt: One friendly black cat with green eyes sitting upright, its fur clearly black, plain light background.
images.accept: description says the cat is black

after_all: Run a final verification: every wired option's new image has a catalog description whose contents match its question's requirement. Print a summary table (id, attempts, wired question count). Any image still failing after 4 attempts: leave the old image in place, report to Chris.
